title: FP&A Analyst
description:
Position Summary 
 The FPA Analyst will own budgeting, forecasting, actuals reporting and variance analysis for assigned Engineering, IT and non-engineering cost centers and projects. The role also supports month-end closing activities, headcount reporting, project finance (WBS, capitalization, Workday Projects) and ad-hoc / scenario-based analysis for India leadership (SMT), Engineering Directors and global finance teams. The ideal candidate is hands-on, detail-oriented and comfortable working in Workday Adaptive Planning, SAP and advanced Excel to deliver accurate, timely and well-explained numbers. 
 
 Job Details 
 Job Title: FPA Analyst Experience: 5-7 years Location: Hybrid Role: Third Party Payrolls 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Budgeting Forecasting: Prepare annual budgets and monthly forecasts for assigned cost centers and projects; load them into the planning system; run scenario analysis. Variance Analysis: Analyze actuals vs budget, prior forecast and prior year (monthly and YTD), with bridges and clear commentary. Headcount Reporting: Consolidate and report headcount; align with approved positions and budget; reconcile to cost centers. Month-End Close: Support month-end close, including journal entries, accruals and reconciliations, in coordination with the accounting team. Project Finance Capitalization: Set up WBS projects in SAP; monitor AUCs and quarterly releases to Fixed Assets; run amortization simulations; support Workday Projects (budget setup, resource and project loading, labor-rate tie-outs); reconcile Workday Projects to SAP; support mid-year project labor absorption and cap rates; maintain the Plan of Record (POR) repository for NPD/NFD projects. Reporting Ad-hoc Analysis: Prepare management reporting packages and dashboards; deliver ad-hoc and business case analysis for leadership. Controls Documentation: Keep reconciliations and audit support current; maintain process documentation. Recurring Deliverables: Month-end close journals; Accurate, on-time close support; Actuals variance reporting; Variances vs budget, prior forecast, prior year; Forecast headcount reporting; Forecast load and headcount reconciliation/ reporting BU wise; Project reporting reconciliations; Project actuals, variances, bridges; Workday Projects-to-SAP reconciliations and tie-outs; WD Project Systems forecast; WBS project set-up AUC monitoring; SAP WBS set-up; AUC monitoring and releases to Fixed Assets; Budget preparation scenarios; Annual budget load and scenario analysis. 
 
 Required Qualifications Skills 
 
 Experience 
 5-7 years in FPA, business finance or financial analysis, ideally in a corporate / captive / GCC environment with budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis ownership 
 
 Must have 
 Education: Bachelors in Commerce, Finance or Accounting; MBA, CA, CMA or CFA preferred Excel modeling: Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, SUMIFS, multi-tab models); strong variance, bridge and scenario modeling skills Planning tools: Hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning (or similar EPM tool) for forecast and budget loads ERP / finance systems: Working knowledge of SAP (FI/CO, WBS / project systems, fixed assets); exposure to month-end close and journal entries BI / dashboards: Power BI or Tableau Communication: Explains variances clearly to non-finance stakeholders 
 
 Good to have 
 Headcount cost center analysis: Experience with HC planning, reporting and reconciliation Workday Projects: Experience with Workday Projects set-up and reconciliation Capitalization amortization: Familiarity with AUC, capitalization and amortization simulations BI / dashboards: Power BI or Tableau for dashboards and reporting Working style: Detail-oriented, deadline-driven, self-starter, comfortable with multiple recurring cycles and ad-hoc requests

The candidate will be responsible for maintaining customer records, coordinating with sales, accounts, legal, and project teams, handling customer queries, tracking payment schedules, and ensuring a smooth and satisfactory customer experience.
 Key Responsibilities 
1. Customer Relationship Management
 Manage customer communication and maintain strong relationships with property buyers. Handle customer queries, requests, complaints, and escalations professionally. Provide timely updates to customers regarding project progress, construction status, and possession schedules. Ensure timely follow-ups and resolution of customer concerns. 2. Booking & Documentation
 Coordinate with the sales team for new bookings and customer handovers to the CRM department. Maintain customer files, booking forms, allotment letters, agreements, and other relevant documents. Verify customer details and ensure proper documentation as per company policies. Maintain accurate and updated customer information in the CRM software. 3. Payment Follow-ups & Coordination
 Coordinate with the accounts and finance teams regarding customer payment schedules and outstanding dues. Send payment reminders and follow up with customers for pending instalments. Track payment receipts, outstanding amounts, and payment-related queries. Assist in resolving discrepancies related to customer accounts and payment records. 4. Interdepartmental Coordination
 Coordinate with sales, accounts, legal, construction, and possession teams to resolve customer issues. Track pending requests and ensure timely closure within defined timelines. Facilitate coordination for property registration, agreement execution, and possession formalities. Maintain records of customer commitments and ensure appropriate follow-up with concerned departments. 5. Possession & Post-Sales Support
 Assist in the preparation and coordination of possession-related documentation. Coordinate site visits, property inspections, snag-list resolution, and possession handovers. Support customers with registration formalities, utility connections, and other possession-related requirements, as applicable. Handle post-possession complaints and coordinate with the concerned teams for resolution. 
 
6. MIS & Reporting
 Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly CRM reports. Maintain records of bookings, cancellations, customer requests, pending payments, complaints, and possession status. Track customer satisfaction, complaint resolution timelines, and pending activities. Maintain accurate data in CRM software and MS Excel for management reporting. Required Qualifications & Skills 
 Graduate in any discipline; a qualification in business administration or management will be an advantage. 3 - 5 years of experience in CRM, preferably in the real estate or property development industry. Good communication and customer-handling skills. Working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Office, and CRM software. Strong coordination, follow-up, documentation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple customer requests and meet deadlines. A customer-centric attitude with strong attention to detail. Key Competencies 
 Customer relationship management Real estate post-sales coordination Payment follow-ups and documentation Complaint and escalation management Interdepartmental coordination MIS preparation and data management Time management and ownership Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Timely resolution of customer queries and complaints. Accuracy and completeness of customer records. Timely payment follow-ups and outstanding dues coordination. Completion of documentation within defined timelines. Customer satisfaction and service quality. Timely closure of possession-related activities. Accuracy and timely submission of CRM reports. Preferred Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be organized, proactive, and capable of managing customer relationships professionally. Prior experience in a real estate developer company, particularly in post-sales CRM, payment coordination, documentation, and possession management, will be preferred.

title: Service Delivery Manager - Payroll
description:
Service Delivery Manager Payroll Global Process Owner, Payroll & Reward Operations (R2P) 
 Tower: Reward to Pay (R2P) Location: Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub) Reports to: HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida Role type: People manager Scope: Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings 
 ABOUT THE HUB Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 
 ROLE PURPOSE You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Transition and shared services set-up Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates. Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions. Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover. Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay. Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars. 2. Process ownership and service delivery Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control. Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks. Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off. Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed. Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure. 3. Governance, risk and controls Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards. Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines. Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date. Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law. 4. Continuous improvement and digital Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law. Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics. Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts. 5. People leadership, performance and culture Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. 
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 90 days: R2P operating model, country wave plan and control framework signed off. By go-live: first wave of countries live in Noida after successful parallel runs. Within 12–18 months: vendor consolidation on track, zero critical errors sustained, and a clean audit outcome. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Indicative target Payroll accuracy: 99.5% of payslips error-free; zero critical errors On-time payment: 100% of payrolls paid on the scheduled date Off-cycle payments: Reduced quarter on quarter; every case root-caused Statutory compliance: Zero penalties; 100% filings on time Vendor SLA adherence: 98% against contracted SLAs Cost per payslip: Year-on-year reduction against baseline Audit outcome: No high-rated findings 
 Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines. 
 TECHNICAL SKILLS Deep multi-country payroll expertise covering gross-to-net, statutory deductions, tax and social security, and year-end. Payroll vendor and aggregator management (for example ADP, Ramco, Alight, or in-country providers), including contract and SLA governance. Payroll controls, SOX-style frameworks and audit management. Integration of HRIS (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors) with time and payroll systems, including interface monitoring. Payroll accounting, GL reconciliation and working knowledge of benefits administration. Parallel-run design, cutover planning and hypercare. 
 LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES Builds teams from zero Customer-centric leadership Drives change and adoption Sound judgement under pressure Influences without authority across countries Data-led decision making Coaches and develops talent Holds a high bar on control 
 EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS Essential 15+ years in HR operations, including 8+ years leading multi-country payroll. Has led at least one payroll transition or vendor consolidation into a shared services centre. Has run payroll for 10,000+ employees across several jurisdictions. Master's degree in HR, Finance, Business or a related field. Preferred Payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP or equivalent) Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or above Experience across Europe, Middle East, Africa or APAC payroll 
 KEY STAKEHOLDERS Hub Director, Global Reward and Payroll leadership, Finance and Tax, Internal Audit, country HR leads, payroll vendors, HRIS team, IT relevant.

title: Purchase Executive / Asst. Manager / Manager
description:
About Intensiv-Filter Himenviro Intensiv-Filter Himenviro (IFH) is a clean-air technology company with more than 100 years of filtration expertise, dating back to 1922. We design, manufacture, install and service industrial air pollution control equipment, including bag filters, reverse air baghouses, electrostatic precipitators and hybrid filters, for cement, steel, power, chemical, food and other process industries, with teams in India and Germany and customers worldwide. 
 About the role You will handle day-to-day procurement for our manufacturing and project requirements: sourcing, comparing quotations, placing orders and following up with vendors until the material arrives. A good knowledge of sheet-metal components is important. The role involves regular visits to vendors in the Delhi NCR area. 
 Key responsibilities Handle purchase activities for project, engineering and plant requirements on new and ongoing projects. Float purchase enquiries to vendors, collect quotations and prepare comparative statements with price and cost analysis. Negotiate with vendors and place purchase orders after approval. Prepare and process purchase requisitions and purchase orders accurately, with correct specifications, quantities and delivery dates. Follow up with vendors against delivery dates and expedite where material is at risk of delay. Ensure uninterrupted supply of the right material, in the right quality and quantity, at the right time. Review vendor terms and agreements to secure good price and quality. Identify and develop new vendors for sheet-metal components and other regular requirements. Coordinate with project, stores, quality and accounts teams on delivery, quality and payment issues. Verify vendor invoices against orders and receipts, and forward them for payment. 
 What success looks like Material reaches the plant when production needs it. Orders are placed on properly compared quotations at competitive prices. Purchase orders are accurate and rarely need correction. Vendors are followed up before a delay becomes a shortage. 
 What you bring Essential Diploma, B.E. / B.Tech or Graduate degree. 6-11 years of experience in purchase / procurement in manufacturing or sheet-metal industries. Good knowledge of sheet-metal components and items. Ability to compare quotations, negotiate and follow up persistently with vendors. Working knowledge of MS Excel and accurate documentation. Ability to travel locally for frequent vendor visits. 
 Preferred Diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering. Experience with ERP-based purchasing. Existing knowledge of sheet-metal and fabrication vendors in Delhi NCR. Ability to read basic drawings and bills of material. 
 Behavioural requirements Persistence Follows up with vendors until the material actually arrives. 
 Integrity Deals with vendors fairly and transparently. 
 Accuracy Gets specifications, quantities and dates right the first time. 
 Responsiveness Keeps production and projects informed of what is coming and when. 
 Why join IFH A solid grounding in procurement for engineered, project-based manufacturing. Exposure to a wide range of materials, from sheet metal to bought-out equipment. Daily interaction with production, projects and vendors.

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.   As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.   Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence. 
Job Profile Summary The Third Party Risk Senior Associate supports the day-to-day operations of the Third-Party Risk Management pillar within Consulting Quality & Risk Management. Based in Noida, this position will provide third-party risk management (TPRM) expertise to maintain and evolve Crowe Consulting’s TPRM program. The position will be responsible for supporting Consulting’s daily TPRM queue, operations, reporting, and process improvement while working on a team under the direction of the Consulting TPRM program leader. 
Key Responsibilities Provide support to Crowe Consulting partners and other leaders regarding third-party matters, including, but not limited to, risk assessments, Request for Proposal (RFP) support, and findings remediation. Proactively monitor TPRM requests and identify stalled, slow-moving, or stopped matters for resolution or escalation. Monitor the Q&RM mailbox and administer the day-to-day workflow, including the review, execution, triage, follow-up, and finalization of inquiries and requests. Partner with internal stakeholders—including Information Security, Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Risk Management, and business unit leaders—to ensure alignment on responses and supporting documentation. Assist in the preparation of TPRM-related reports, ensuring accurate data capture and up-to-date documentation. Maintain clear handoffs and documentation to support seamless coordination with U.S.-based team members. Help identify and implement improvements to third-party risk management processes, working with TPRM leadership to streamline workflows and reduce inefficiencies. Update policies and procedures and educate the Consulting team on key TPRM risk issues. Maintain insight into trends and changes in the TPRM landscape through industry insights, partnerships, and ongoing development.  Support firmwide risk management changes, including, but not limited to, technology transformation, process changes, and training and education.  Provide value-added recommendations and share best practices with the Consulting team. Support the Enterprise Risk Management program and additional risk domains, as required. 
Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree. Experience: Senior Associate: 3+ years of relevant experience, with a demonstrated ability to manage TPRM activities independently. Demonstrated problem-solving skills to identify quality, risk, and compliance issues and develop processes to prevent or detect future issues. Demonstrated professionalism and confidentiality when handling sensitive information. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet critical deadlines in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while maintaining accuracy and quality. Team-oriented, with experience working with diverse teams. Ability to leverage available resources and contribute through others. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across teams, time zones, and levels of seniority. High attention to detail and strong organizational skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, ServiceNow, and AI productivity tools. Willingness to participate in both routine Quality & Risk Management (Q&RM) tasks and strategic cross functional projects. US Collaboration: willingness to work 4–5 hours of daily live overlap with U.S. Eastern Time (EST/EDT) teams for standups, handovers, and real-time collaboration to start. Candidate must have reliable means of commuting to and from local office. 
Preferred Qualifications Experience working in the professional services or financial services industry. General knowledge of banking compliance. Experience working with commercially available TPRM and/or GRC solutions. Relevant professional certifications preferred. Experience in project management. Experience working in a global capability center or similar distributed operating model supporting U.S.-based stakeholders. 
Work Environment This role sits within a growing, fast-paced Third-Party Risk Management function supporting a high volume of consulting engagements. Priorities can shift quickly, and the Senior Associate should be comfortable balancing routine, standardized work with time-sensitive requests. The role is based in Noida, India, and works extended hours to provide coverage aligned with U.S. business-day overlap. US collaboration is required with shift flexibility possible upon demonstration of functional proficiency.   We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. title: Chartered Accountant
description:
Role Summary This is a high-ownership role for a qualified CA with 45 years of experience who has worked across depth and breadth in the service sector as operator / auditor and is now ready to move into an operating finance role. You will be the custodian of accounting accuracy, tax compliance, and reporting discipline for the group, while working closely with the CEO's office, business teams, and external stakeholders such as banks, auditors, and consultants. The ideal candidate combines technical depth with the maturity to communicate financial matters clearly to non-finance stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Accounting & Financial Reporting Ensure books of accounts are maintained accurately as per Indian GAAP, with working knowledge of Ind AS applicability and disclosures relevant to the group's evolving scale. Drive periodic (monthly/quarterly/annual) closing within defined timelines, ensuring accuracy and completeness of financial statements. Prepare and review Balance Sheet reconciliations, ledger scrutiny, and schedules supporting the financial statements. Own MIS reporting timely, accurate, and insight-driven dashboards/reports for management review. Support ICFR (Internal Controls over Financial Reporting) design, documentation, testing, and remediation tracking. 2. Direct Tax Compliance Manage end-to-end TDS compliance (Salary and Non-Salary) computation, deposit, quarterly returns, and reconciliation with Form 26AS/AIS. Prepare and file Income Tax Returns (ITR) for group entities. Coordinate and manage Tax Audits (Form 3CD and annexures) with statutory/tax auditors. Handle scrutiny assessments, notices, and departmental correspondence, including preparing submissions and liaising with consultants/counsel where required. 3. Indirect Tax Compliance Own GST compliance across multiple state registrations monthly/annual return filings (GSTR-1, 3B, 9/9C), and timely reconciliations (GSTR-2B vs books, e-invoicing where applicable). Manage Input Service Distributor (ISD) compliance and cross-charge/credit distribution mechanics across states. Lead GST audits and departmental reviews; draft and coordinate responses to GST notices and queries in a timely, well-documented manner. Proactively track changes in GST law/notifications/circulars and assess impact on the business. 4. Fixed Assets & Debtors Control Maintain the Fixed Assets Register additions, disposals, capitalisation, depreciation (Companies Act and Income Tax), and periodic physical verification. Own debtors control — ageing analysis, collections follow-up coordination, provisioning for doubtful debts, and reconciliation of client/customer accounts. Work with business teams to resolve billing/collection discrepancies and tighten receivables discipline. 5. Treasury & Banking Manage day-to-day banking relationships across group entities — operations, facilities, and documentation. Monitor and ensure compliance with loan/facility covenants, and coordinate timely submission of required certifications/data to lenders. Handle Bank Guarantees — issuance, renewal, tracking of margin money/collateral, and coordination with banks and business teams on client-mandated BG requirements. Support cash flow visibility and working capital coordination with the treasury/finance team. 6. Systems, Controls & Process Improvement Work extensively in Tally, including cost centre–based accounting for entity/function/project-level visibility. Identify and drive automation opportunities in accounting, reconciliation, and reporting processes using MS Excel and other tools. Maintain documentation and audit trails consistent with best-practice control standards. 7. Team, Communication & Cross-Functional Interaction Lead and mentor a small team of accounts — reviewing work, building capability, and ensuring accountability. Act as a key liaison between Finance and other functions (Operations, HR, Procurement, Business Heads) to ensure smooth month-end processes, vendor/client account matters, and compliance data flows. Communicate clearly and confidently with statutory auditors, tax consultants, bankers, and regulatory authorities. Prepare clear, concise summaries and escalate risk areas proactively to the CFO/Controller with recommended courses of action rather than just raising issues. 
 Desired Candidate Profile Experience & Background Mandatory: Qualified Chartered Accountant with 4–5 years of post-qualification experience, either with a mid-sized corporate or a CA firm with strong statutory audit exposure in the service sector. Solid grip on Indian GAAP; working familiarity with Ind AS. Demonstrated hands-on (not just supervisory) experience in TDS, ITR filing, tax audits, and handling scrutiny/assessment matters. Practical experience with multi-state GST compliance, including ISD, reconciliations, audits, and notice handling. Experience with periodic closing, MIS, balance sheet reconciliation, ICFR, fixed assets accounting, and debtors control. Exposure to banking/treasury operations, covenant tracking, and bank guarantee management is a strong plus. Education Chartered Accountant (CA) – mandatory qualification. Key Skills & Competencies Proficient in Tally (cost centre accounting) and advanced MS Excel; an aptitude for process automation will be valued. Strong communication skills — able to explain financial/compliance matters to both finance and non-finance stakeholders. Prior experience managing or mentoring a small team, with a collaborative, cross-functional working style. High degree of ownership, integrity, and comfort operating in a compliance-first, deadline-driven environment.

Prepare state-wise GST liability and payment statements, including ITC, cash payments and challans. Verify GST TDS entries uploaded by government departments and other deductors. 2. GST Return Filing Prepare and file GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and ISD returns, wherever applicable. Review and process entries appearing in GSTR-2B. Prepare and file GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C, wherever applicable. Coordinate with the concerned SAO team for verification and finalization of ITC. Obtain necessary clarifications from DCFO, CAO and State GST Consultants, wherever required. Prepare consolidated data for GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C. Review discrepancies and incorporate necessary corrections before finalization. Maintain GST records and supporting documents for audit and compliance purposes. 5. TDS Compliance & Return Filing Prepare and file salary and non-salary TDS returns using Computax software, in accordance with applicable statutory requirements. Prepare TDS liability statements covering tax, interest and late fees. Prepare section-wise and service-wise TDS reports for balance sheet and statutory audit purposes. Calculate employee salary tax liability based on applicable tax regimes, slabs, deductions and rebates. Download and coordinate the distribution of applicable TDS certificates, including Form 16 and Form 16A. Prepare and file revised TDS returns, wherever required. Handle TDS defaults, notices and outstanding demands through the TRACES Portal. 6. Documentation, Audit & Coordination Maintain systematic physical and digital records of GST and TDS documents.  Leverage Edu is looking for a highly driven Key Account Manager to expand and manage strategic partnerships for Online Degree Programs. The candidate will be responsible for onboarding and driving business through education consultants, test prep institutes, upskilling centers, corporates, colleges, and digital partners while ensuring strong lead generation and admissions growth.

 Provides financial data preparation, reconciliations, variance analysis, and process consistency support for the E&E FP&A CoE. Ensures accurate, reliable financial information, strengthens data integrity and processes, and enables Business Decision Support teams and stakeholders to make informed financial decisions. 
 
 Accountabilities

 Process Execution & Standardisation & Efficiency 
 Execute standardised financial processes, reporting frameworks, and data governance standards, ensuring consistent data structures, process compliance, and continuous improvement through identification of inefficiencies and enhancement opportunities. 
 
 Support to BDS Teams

 Essential

 Desirable

Process discipline - reliable execution of standardised processes, templates and workflows. EPM systems proficiency - strong working knowledge of Anaplan, and experience working with SAP and associated reporting tools. Attention to detail - consistently high levels of accuracy and completeness. Clear communication - able to summarise financial data simply for internal stakeholders. title: Delivery Manager Operations - Finance ( O2C or R2R)
description:
Pay Band : 6 Country/Location: Noida, India Department: GSS English & Exams (IELTS Operations) Contract Type : 1 Year Fixed term contract  
 Work Schedule: This is a 24/7 on-site role with rotating shifts, including night shifts. The position offers two days off per week, which may not always fall on weekends. Flexibility and adaptability to a continuous shift-based environment are essential. There is no hybrid work arrangement for this position, and it requires working onsite five days a week  
 Training & Assessment Requirement 
Successful candidates will be required to complete mandatory process training and achieve the required pass mark in a competency assessment before undertaking independent production responsibilities. Support, coaching, and reassessment opportunities will be provided where applicable. 
 Role Description/Purpose The Delivery Manager Operations is responsible for leading and managing end-to-end Finance Operations service delivery to ensure it is efficient, scalable, and consistently meets business and customer expectations. The role focuses on designing and implementing robust service delivery frameworks, including workforce planning, utilisation, and process optimisation, while ensuring adherence to defined service level agreements and quality standards. It plays a critical role in driving continuous improvement, standardisation, and operational excellence across shared services, while proactively identifying and mitigating risks to ensure business continuity. The role also ensures strong governance, reporting, and compliance practices, enabling reliable and high-quality outcomes for stakeholders and customers in a global operating environment. 
 Qualifications & Experience Graduation in Commerce Written and verbal proficiency in English (British Council systems and global processes operate in English) 7+ years of experience in Finance Operations (O2C / R2R) / Shared Services 4+ years of people management experience Strong understanding of finance governance and controls Experience in reporting, dashboards, and MIS Experience in operational delivery in a global/shared services environment Strong understanding of Finance Operations & Shared Services delivery Expertise in financial governance and compliance frameworks Advanced stakeholder management and communication skills Desirable: Lean / Six Sigma certification Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.) Experience in transitions / migrations Exposure to global capability centres 
 Role Accountabilities The role operates within the English & Examinations business, a key strategic and revenue-generating unit of the organisation, delivering services across a global network of over 100 countries. It functions in a shared services environment that supports multi-country operations, requiring high levels of standardisation, automation, and efficiency in processes. The Delivery Manager must balance ongoing service delivery with transformation and digital initiatives in a cost-conscious and resource-constrained setting, working closely with global and regional stakeholders to ensure alignment with business priorities, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements, while maintaining uninterrupted service delivery. 
 You will lead end-to-end delivery of Finance Operations services, defining and implementing service delivery frameworks covering staffing, scheduling and utilisation, and ensuring SLA compliance and high-quality customer interactions. You will establish escalation mechanisms and helpdesk structures, monitor risks and ensure mitigation and business continuity planning, and drive process standardisation to reduce operational inefficiencies. You will also ensure adherence to information security policies (ISO 27001/22301), monitor access controls and compliance within your teams, drive a security awareness and incident reporting culture, and ensure immediate action is taken in case of non-compliance or risks. 
 You will maintain strong engagement with internal and external stakeholders, communicating performance, issues and insights to leadership, managing MIS reporting on a daily, weekly and monthly basis, aligning service delivery with stakeholder expectations, and facilitating stakeholder reviews, governance forums and visits. On people and resource management, you will manage recruitment, onboarding and training of teams, drive performance management and productivity improvements, implement engagement and retention initiatives, and build a high-performing, motivated operations team. 
 On quality, you will ensure compliance with internal and external quality standards, deliver against KPIs and quality benchmarks, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and manage customer feedback and complaint resolution. On governance and reporting, you will provide insights through dashboards, reports and analytics, ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory and legal requirements, identify, assess and manage operational risks, and strengthen governance frameworks and reporting accuracy.

 Strategic Alliance Management Services P. Ltd. (SAMS) is Indias most respected HR and Recruitment consultancy, exclusively focused on servicing the public health, development and CSR sectors. Established in 1995, SAMS has been associated with a range of clients over the past 28 years which has included the best known, bi and multi-laterals, INGOs and NGOs in the country apart from the Government of India (GoI) and State Governments in the above sectors.
SAMS offers a wide range of integrated, innovative and high-quality consultancy services to international agencies, donors and government, on a pan-India basis. For more information about SAMS, visit https://www.sams.co.in/ or www.samsconsult.com

We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Assistant Manager Finance to oversee the organizations financial operations, accounting processes, and statutory compliance. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting activities, preparing financial reports, coordinating audits, and ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards and tax regulations.

 Work Schedule : This is a 24/7 on-site role with rotating shifts, including night shifts. The position offers two days off per week, which may not always fall on weekends. Flexibility and adaptability to a continuous shift-based environment are essential. There is no hybrid work arrangement for this position, and it requires working onsite five days a week. 
 Training & Assessment Requirement 
Successful candidates will be required to complete mandatory process training and achieve the required pass mark in a competency assessment before undertaking independent production responsibilities. Support, coaching, and reassessment opportunities will be provided where applicable. 
 Role Description/Purpose To provide day-to-day leadership, coaching and operational supervision for the Operations team within Shared Services, ensuring accurate, timely and compliant processing of finance activities such as refunds, accruals, reconciliations, invoice/payment support, payroll inputs, vendor/customer queries, reporting and month-end support. The role holder will act as the first level escalation point for finance process queries, monitor SLA adherence, ensure required evidence is maintained, and contribute to continuous improvement activities led by Operations leadership so that finance services remain reliable, audit-ready and aligned to stakeholder expectations. 
 Qualifications & Experience Essential: Graduate (Mandatory) 5 years or more experience in finance operations (O2C, P2P & R2R), shared services, BPO/back-office operations, accounting support or transaction processing environment At least 2 years of team leading experience, preferably managing a finance operations team of more than 10 people Working knowledge of refunds, accruals, reconciliations, invoice/payment support, payroll inputs, month-end support, reporting or similar finance processes Understanding of finance operations, shared services, BPO/back-office service delivery and transaction processing controls Strong MS Office skills, especially Excel; ability to maintain trackers, reports, reconciliations and dashboards accurately Knowledge of SLA management, queue management, ageing analysis, quality checks, audit evidence and process documentation Good people and interpersonal skills to build effective relationships with team members, managers and finance stakeholders Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle financial, personal and commercially sensitive information appropriately 
 Desirable: Experience in finance shared services, global operations, transition/hypercare support or multi-country finance processes Working knowledge of ERP/finance systems, workflow tools, Power BI, Power Query or advanced Excel reporting Lean/Six Sigma, accounting, finance or process improvement certification would be an advantage 
 Role Accountabilities The British Council Shared Services Centre supports English & Exams operations by delivering standardised, scalable and controlled back-office services across regions and countries. Finance Operations is a critical support function that enables timely and accurate processing of financial transactions, reconciliation activities, refunds, accruals, payroll inputs, reporting and query resolution. The Team Leader Operations will play a key role in managing daily workload, coaching team members, following agreed process controls, supporting month-end and audit requirements, and ensuring consistent team-level service delivery for internal stakeholders and regional finance/business teams. 
 You may be required to work extended hours during month-end, quarter-end, year-end, audit support, transition, training or hiring activities, and will manage high-volume and time-sensitive finance activities while maintaining accuracy, compliance, evidence logs and SLA monitoring within agreed procedures. 
 You will lead and coach Finance Operations team members to deliver accurate, timely and compliant processing of assigned finance activities, identifying risks, bottlenecks and potential SLA breaches early, taking corrective action within agreed procedures, and escalating higher-risk matters to the Delivery Manager using logical analysis and evidence-based information. You will support continuous improvement and process standardisation initiatives led by Operations leadership. You will supervise daily finance operations including refunds, accruals, reconciliations, invoice/payment support, payroll inputs, customer/vendor query handling and reporting activities as applicable to the process, ensuring work allocation, queue management, ageing review, prioritisation and timely closure of finance transactions within agreed SLAs and quality standards. You will act as the first level escalation point within agreed procedures for process queries, exceptions, pending approvals, reconciliation differences, payment/refund issues and stakeholder follow-ups, maintain SOPs, process maps, trackers, workflow notes and knowledge articles, and ensure team members are trained on process updates through a structured knowledge transfer approach. You will support month-end, quarter-end and year-end activities by confirming task completion, evidence availability, open-item status and timely escalation of blockers, and support compliance with finance policies, delegation of authority, approval matrix, audit requirements, documentation standards and agreed control checks by following defined procedures and escalating exceptions. 
 You will maintain effective working relationships with stakeholders and escalate issues where required, monitor team performance, productivity, schedule adherence, attendance, training needs and quality outcomes, and provide feedback through team meetings and one-on-one discussions. You will prepare shift plans, workload plans, handover notes and contingency support for peak finance cycles and critical business deadlines. On quality, controls and compliance, you will perform quality checks, sample reviews, error analysis and root-cause reviews for finance transactions, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are tracked to closure, escalate recurring risks, process gaps and capacity concerns to the Delivery Manager, and support internal and external audit requirements by ensuring documentation, transaction trails and control evidence are complete, accurate and retrievable. 
 On governance and reporting, you will prepare and maintain team-level daily, weekly and monthly finance dashboards, including volume, productivity, SLA, ageing, accuracy, error trends, open risks and escalations, review team-level performance data and recommend operational improvement opportunities to the Delivery Manager, and support compliance with BCMS and British Council policies, finance controls, records management requirements and applicable information security standards by ensuring team activities follow agreed guidance and by escalating exceptions promptly. On information security, you will ensure the team is aware of information security policies and complies with them, ensure the team complies with ISO 27001, IGA and access management requirements, raise incidents or escalate immediately when any non-compliance, data risk or access issue is observed, disable accounts immediately for leavers and absconders or employees on long leave, document, monitor and review access levels for the team, especially for finance systems and shared folders, and provide security awareness and education to team members handling financial and personal data.

title: FS - RC - Actuarial - IFRS17- Life- Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
**Staff, P\&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
 Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high\-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
   

  

 Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on\-the\-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
   

  

 Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a Staff member within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
   

  

 On engagements, you will:
   

  

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Seniors, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members


 Within the actuarial practice you will:
   

  

* Estimate actuarial liability for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Updating the report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 and Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise


 We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
   

  

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 1\+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)

* Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx etc, will be a plus
* Good exam progress


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting.
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues


**What We Offer**

From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

 The GSI Finance \- Billing Process Owner is a strategic advisor and change agent responsible for driving comprehensive automation and transformation of Billing system and process. This role requires a deep understanding of finance function, processes, and technologies to deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, effectiveness, and delivery. The successful candidate will possess a blend of contemporary digital and IT skills, solutions mindset, strategic thinking, operational expertise, and change management skills to lead complex process initiatives, and also lead a keen and capable team.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategy Development and Execution Global Billing process for GSI Business:
* Develop and execute a holistic Billing strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Assess current finance operations, identify pain points, and define target operating models.
* Develop business cases and ROI analysis for automation initiatives.
* Billing Function Optimization, document ‘As\-Is’ and ‘To\-Be’ billing process maps
* Define automation capabilities, focus on process simplification and data accuracy in billing
* Redesign, automate and optimize invoicing processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Implement industry best practices and leverage automation technologies (RPA, AI) to streamline operations.

**Technology Implementation And Adoption**

* Ensure data quality, integrity, and security throughout the invoicing process
* Develop self\-service reporting capabilities to empower business users.


**Change Management**
* Develop and execute comprehensive change management plans to ensure successful adoption of transformation initiatives.
* Build stakeholder buy\-in and manage resistance to change.
* Provide training and support to finance teams throughout the transformation journey.


**Team Leadership And Development**
* Lead and mentor a high\-performing finance transformation team.
* Develop talent and succession plans to build a strong finance organization.
* Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.


**Qualification / Desired Characteristics**
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or related field MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 7 years of experience in finance, with a strong focus on transformation and consulting.
* Proven track record of leading complex finance transformation projects.

description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
 Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation\-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning \& Urban Design, Water, Environment \& Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
   

  

**Ramboll in India**
 Ramboll has more than 1800\+ experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning \& Urban Design, Water, Environment \& Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As our new Controller, you will be part of a skilled, dedicated, and ambitious team, that is dedicated to managing the performance of our global Support functions. As a company we are on a globalization journey busy reporting team, which is overall responsible for the controlling of more than 35 countries and covering a revenue of approx. DKK 14 billion and 100 reporting companies. You will join cost management team, a part of Ramboll’s global finance organization and your work location will be at our offices in
 **Noida, India.**
 As the Controller, you will serve as a trusted advisor to the support organization, focusing on cost management, financial analysis, budgeting, business planning, and performance management. Your role is crucial to ensure transparency and accuracy in financial reporting while providing strategic business partnering support.
   

  

**Your key tasks and responsibilities will be:**
* As a controller and trusted finance partner, you are the custodian of the performance within cost management area.
* Overall responsibility of financial results and financial planning.
* Drive a continuous cost improvement mindset and proactively identifies opportunities to optimize costs by utilizing data driven spend.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and the rest of finance.
* Defining, tracking, and maintaining the sets of KPI’s that are used to steer the function.
* Work closely with the Global head of Finance, functional Director, and local country leadership team.
* Organizing financial reviews together with functional head and head of cost management.
* Being the one for analyses, trends, calculations, and simulations. Support complex business cases.
* Focus on detailed analysis of cost, allocations \& postings, and cost trends.
* Coordinating with local Finance \& accounting controllers. Sparring with them


**Qualifications**
**Your starting point:**
 From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company:
   

  

  

* B.Com and MBA (Finance) or equivalent degree in Finance.
* We are looking for people with a strong analytical mindset that can handle multiple tasks and challenges at hand, while maintaining a good sense of urgency.
* You have 7\+ years of work experience within financial planning \& analysis, and/or experience as a controller or Finance business partner.
* You thrive of challenging the status que and can put together and execute a plan for change.
* You have a positive attitude and have outspoken collaboration skills and work well with stakeholders at all levels.
* Excellent skills in Excel and PowerPoint are a requirement as you will be leading financial modelling. Experience from working with business intelligence systems is an advantage. Today we use systems like Power BI and Jedox.
* You have a solid understanding of financial statement analysis and accounting principles.
* You are a self\-starter, striving for continuous process improvements and hold high attention to the detail.
* Excellent communication skills and mastering the discipline of presenting data in a clear and concise manner is a must.


 Personal qualities that will help you succeed in this role include:
   

  

  

* You are hands\-on with excellent attention to details, and you care passionately about being precise and accurate.
* You can work independently as well as in the team.
* You thrive in a fast\-paced environment with multiple priorities.


 We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible. Please note that interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis.
   

  

**Additional Information**
**What we can offer you**
* Investment in your development
* Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
* Be valued for the unique person you are.
* Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects.
* The long\-term thinking of a foundation\-owned company


**Work at the heart of sustainable change**
 Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realize their full potential.
   

  

**Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do**
 We believe in the strength of diversity and know that unique experiences and perspectives are vital for creating truly sustainable societies. Therefore, we are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can flourish and reach their potential. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage you to contact our recruitment team to discuss any accommodations you need during the application process.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

**Ready to join us?**
 Please submit your application. Be sure to include all relevant documents including your CV, cover letter, etc.
   

  

 Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Software Development Engineer-II (Finance - AI Engineering)
description:
Job Summary Every finance team runs on spreadsheets, tribal knowledge, and manual reconciliation between systems that were never meant to talk to each other. We think thats about to change - and we want the engineer who builds that change here first. This isnt a "finance systems" role. Its not reporting, its not maintaining dashboards, and its not writing SQL for someone elses requirements doc. This is a build role for someone who wants to take a real, high-stakes function - the one that runs the companys numbers, forecasts, and capital decisions - and rebuild it from the ground up as a set of intelligent, autonomous systems. Youll have direct access to the Head of Strategic Finance, the CFOs office, and full latitude to decide how things get built. If youve ever looked at a finance team drowning in manual work and thought "this should just be automated," this is the job where you get to prove it - with real production systems, real business impact, and a leadership team that will move out of your way. Responsibilities A Day in the Life Sit inside the finance function, understand how it actually works - not the theory, the real mess of systems, spreadsheets, close cycles, and judgment calls - and figure out what should never require a human again. Design and build autonomous agents that pull data from multiple systems, reason over it, and produce decision-ready output - not static reports, but systems that plan, check their own work, and flag what actually needs a human. Own the full stack: data pipelines, integrations across ERP/CRM/finance systems, orchestration logic, and the AI layer that sits on top of all of it. Make sharp build-vs-buy calls - know when to write code, when to use an existing tool, and when to reach for an LLM instead of a rules engine. Ship fast, in production, with real users depending on your systems for actual financial decisions - not prototypes that live in a demo forever. Be the person who defines what "AI-native finance" even means at Innovaccer, because right now, nobody has done it yet. What You Need Youve built AI agents before. Not called an API and wrapped a chat UI around it - actually designed multi-step, tool-using, autonomous or semi-autonomous systems that do real work with minimal human babysitting. Youre a strong engineer, full stop. Solid computer science fundamentals, clean system design instincts, and the ability to take ambiguous problems and turn them into working software without a spec handed to you. Youre comfortable with the modern AI toolchain - LLM APIs, agentic frameworks, coding assistants (Claude, Codex, and similar), prompt and context engineering, evaluation and guardrails. You know the difference between a cool demo and something thats reliable enough to run a business process. Youre genuinely curious about how a business runs. You dont need a finance background - you need the instinct to walk into an unfamiliar domain, ask sharp questions, and quickly figure out the actual workflow before you write a line of code. You default to automation. When you see a repetitive process, your first thought is "why is a human doing this," not "let me build a dashboard so a human can do it faster." You can work with ambiguity and incomplete requirements. This function is being invented in real time - youll often be defining the problem, not just solving it.
